english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical or figurative obstacle.
Use 障礙 as the all-purpose noun for an obstacle or impediment, especially an abstract one.
This is the all-purpose choice for a hindrance or an impairment, with context showing which sense is meant.
This is the all-purpose noun for something that obstructs progress or creates difficulty.
This is the all-purpose noun for something that blocks progress or makes an activity harder.
Use this for something that obstructs or prevents progress.
Use this for a figurative barrier or obstacle, including a psychological or emotional one.
Use this when the disadvantage is specifically an obstacle or hindrance, rather than merely a weakness or downside.

examples.english: The biggest obstacle in this project is a lack of funding.
examples.traditional: 呢個工程最大嘅障礙係資金不足。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6 hai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1

examples.english: This technical barrier still hasn't been solved.
examples.traditional: 呢個技術障礙仲未解決。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei6 seot6 zoeng3 ngoi6 zung6 mei6 gaai2 kyut3

examples.english: The language handicap makes communication difficult.
examples.traditional: 語言障礙令我哋溝通得唔係咁順。
examples.jyutping: jyu5 jin4 zoeng3 ngoi6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 gau1 tung1 dak1 m4 hai6 gam3 seon6

examples.english: This technical problem became an impediment to the progress of the plan.
examples.traditional: 呢個技術問題成為計劃推進嘅障礙。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4 sing4 wai4 gai3 waak6 teoi1 zeon3 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6

examples.english: The heavy rain became a hindrance to the project's progress.
examples.traditional: 呢場大雨成為工程進度嘅障礙。
examples.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 sing4 wai4 gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6

examples.english: Lack of money is the biggest bar to our progress.

examples.jyutping: mou5 cin2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zeon3 bou6 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 zoeng3 ngoi6
